cardInfo.summary: DIRECT ADOPTION, FLOATING RANGE. This instance names ^1.0.0 rather than a Version, and the store answers with a redirect to whatever satisfies it — 1.3.0 today. It follows the 1.x line as it is maintained and stops at the major boundary. Nothing about this instance changes when it moves; the answer to the question it asks changes.
